datasets.name: ODSAccount
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   acc.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider, ownid, t.ostat, t.pok_ostat
FROM ACCOUNT /*partition (activacc)*/ acc, tenostat t
where  t.acc_id = acc.id
and
 ownid = :ownid
and acc.close_dat is null
ORDER BY 
   acc_no

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.rowid, ic.ID , ic.kli_id, ic.loanacc_id, ic.curracc_id,
                 ii.NAME, ii.mainformguid, ii.changeguid,
                 ii.suggestionguid, ii.policyguid, ii.mainformname AS tablename, ic.policy_num,
                 trunc(ic.ins_date) as ins_date, ic.ammount, ic.begin_date, ic.end_date, av.val_name,
                  ic.inssumm, ic.tariff, ic.franshiz, ic.state, ic.type_id  
                 FROM ins_contracts ic, ins_insurances ii, avalute av
                 WHERE ii.ID = ic.type_id
               
                 and close_prefix=0
                 and ic.valute_id = av.valute(+)

datasets.name: ODSLoanAccLists
datasets.sql:
SELECT ID, acc_no, bal_cn1, name
  FROM ACCOUNT partition (activacc)
 WHERE bal_cn1 IN (SELECT bal_cn
                    FROM ins_acc_bal_cn
                   WHERE dict_id = (SELECT MAX (value)
                                      FROM ins_settings
                                     WHERE NAME = 'LOANID'))

datasets.name: ODSCurrAccList
